abstract: PURPOSE: Massive sacrococcygeal teratomas are typically resected and closed in a "chevron" fashion. The resultant scar may leave protuberant "dog ears" and extend across and below the infragluteal creases down onto the posterior thighs, causing undesirable buttock deformity. Given the redundant skin often available, the authors sought to develop a closure technique to minimize deformity and unpleasant scars. METHODS: At the time of resection of 2 sacrococcygeal teratomas, attention was directed to minimizing redundant skin, restoring normal buttock contour, and avoiding scars crossing the infragluteal crease. After properly securing the anal location, serial polygonal skin excisions were performed, working the excess tissue centrally rather than peripherally, leaving 2 right-angled scars on each buttock. RESULTS: Each infant underwent successful reconstruction with a normal buttock contour without redundancy. All scars on the buttocks can be easily covered by bathing attire. CONCLUSIONS: The excess skin expanded by large sacrococcygeal teratomas affords an opportunity to apply straightforward tissue rearrangement principles to reconstruct the buttocks with a normal contour and hidden scars.
abstract_ja: 目的：巨大仙尾部奇形腫は通常シェブロン状に縫合されるが、その瘢痕により臀部の突出（ドッグイヤー）や、殿溝を越えて後大腿部に広がる瘢痕変形が生じることがある。本研究は、この変形を最小限にする縫合法を開発することを目的とした。方法：仙尾部奇形腫2例の切除時に、余剰皮膚を最小限にし、正常な臀部輪郭を回復させ、殿溝をまたぐ瘢痕を避けることに注意を払った。肛門位置を確実に固定した後、多角形の皮膚切除を連続して行い、余剰組織を周辺ではなく中心へ寄せ、臀部に直角状の瘢痕を各側2本ずつ残した。結果：両児とも、余剰のない正常な臀部輪郭の再建に成功した。臀部のすべての瘢痕は水着で容易に覆うことができる。結論：大きな仙尾部奇形腫によって拡張した余剰皮膚を利用すれば、単純な組織再配置の原理を応用して、正常な輪郭と目立たない瘢痕で臀部を再建できる。
